patterns: APPSC asks 'What is X?' one-liners: PINAKA (MBRL), Varunastra (torpedo), AWACS, TAPAS-201 (MALE UAV), Surya VHF radar, Tavasya (frigate).
AP tilt: Visakhapatnam (NSTL, HSL, Eastern Naval Command) and recent naval commissionings/decommissionings as statement items (2024 APPSC Cheetah/Guldar/Magar trap).
Explosives (gun cotton = cellulose nitrate, RDX = cyclonite, Nobel oil = TNG, Amatol has no nitroglycerine) are a recurring chemistry-linked cluster across PSCs.
Aircraft role matching (IL-76 transport vs IL-78 tanker, C-130J USA, Dornier maritime patrol) recurs in UPSC/state PSCs.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement 2025-26 current-affairs details (orders, delivery dates, lab names) much deeper than APPSC's single-fact style.
